rooms.name: Front Courtyard
rooms.desc: A wide courtyard of broken flagstones before the keep, its walls rising ninety feet on every side. The doors of the keep stand open under torches.
rooms.dm: Lightning and rain; the gate behind the party swings shut on its own if Strahd wills it.

rooms.name: Servants' Courtyard
rooms.desc: A narrow courtyard between the keep and the eastern wall; a carriage house stands in the corner.
rooms.dm: The door into the keep (K23) is swollen shut: DC 10 Strength.

rooms.name: Servants' Courtyard (south)
rooms.desc: The courtyard continues round the south-east of the keep.

rooms.name: Carriage House
rooms.desc: A stone carriage house with hinged wooden doors.
rooms.dm: The black carriage with glass windows and brass lanterns; the horses are elsewhere.

rooms.name: Chapel Garden
rooms.desc: A struggling garden behind the keep under boarded stained-glass windows.

rooms.name: Overlook
rooms.desc: A stone balcony beyond the east wall, open to the storm.
rooms.dm: The village lies a thousand feet below. Perception 15: a stone box with three dirty windows juts from the cliff a hundred feet down (K63, the wine cellar).

rooms.name: Turret Post (north-west)
rooms.desc: An octagonal turret room thirty feet across under a domed ceiling with faded frescoes; arrow slits in every wall.

rooms.name: Turret Post (south-west)
rooms.desc: An octagonal turret room thirty feet across under a domed ceiling with faded frescoes; arrow slits in every wall.

rooms.name: Turret Post Access Hall (north)
rooms.desc: A plain hall linking the turrets.

rooms.name: Turret Post Access Hall (west)
rooms.desc: A plain hall linking the turrets.

rooms.name: Turret Post Access Hall (south)
rooms.desc: A plain hall linking the turrets.

rooms.name: North Archers' Post
rooms.desc: A post with arrow slits looking out over the courtyard.

rooms.name: South Archers' Post
rooms.desc: A post with arrow slits looking out over the courtyard.

rooms.name: Spiral Stair
rooms.desc: A dark spiral stair behind a door.
rooms.dm: From K78 (-80) past K83a to K37 (+90).

rooms.name: Grand Staircase
rooms.desc: A broad staircase of worn stone climbing into darkness.
rooms.dm: Up 30 ft to K19, the grand landing.

rooms.name: Entry
rooms.desc: An entry hall twenty feet deep between two sets of doors, torches guttering in iron sconces. Four stone dragons glare down from the vaulted ceiling.
rooms.dm: The dragons are red dragon wyrmlings: they attack anyone entering from K8 who is not Strahd, never anyone coming in from the courtyard.

rooms.name: Great Entry
rooms.desc: A great dusty hall under a dome ringed with eight stone gargoyles, columns strung with cobwebs, torches guttering. Bronze doors east and south; a wide staircase climbs north into the dark.
rooms.dm: Gargoyles (8) attack anyone who leaves and returns. Rahadin descends the stair to greet invited guests and leads them to K10.

rooms.name: Turret Access Hall
rooms.desc: A long hall draped in cobwebs; life-sized statues of knights line both sides. Double doors stand at each end, a bronze sun above the eastern pair.
rooms.dm: The statues are only statues; cobwebs cut sight to a few feet.

rooms.name: North Chapel Access
rooms.desc: An arched room with alcoves holding eight-foot statues of helmed knights; a creaking wooden stair rises to the west.

rooms.name: South Chapel Access
rooms.desc: An arched room with alcoves holding eight-foot statues of helmed knights; a stair landing to the west, steps curling down and up.
rooms.dm: Down is blocked by new masonry 10 ft below; up climbs into cobwebs.

rooms.name: Chapel
rooms.desc: The ancient chapel: a dome ninety feet overhead, bats among the rafters, broken stained glass boarded up, a balcony along the west wall. An altar on a platform at the east end, a cloaked figure draped across it, a black mace on the floor.
rooms.dm: The figure is a corpse (the mace is a holy symbol's resting place per the card reading). Strahd may be among the bats. The balcony is K28 (+50).

rooms.name: Guests' Hall
rooms.desc: A hall with a suit of armour in a shallow alcove; double doors to the west stand ajar, organ music and bright light spilling through them. An arched hallway runs east.
rooms.dm: The armour is only armour. The east hallway ends at the south tower stair (K21).

rooms.name: Arched Hallway
rooms.desc: An arched hallway twenty feet long.

rooms.name: Dining Hall
rooms.desc: A dining hall laid for a feast under a crystal chandelier; a pipe organ thunders at the far wall.
rooms.dm: The food is real but the gracious host is Strahd; the organ plays itself. The scene is a trap of hospitality.

rooms.name: Elevator Shaft
rooms.desc: A rectangular shaft, cold and mildewed, iron chains taut up and down it.
rooms.dm: The elevator trap's shaft (see K61).

rooms.name: High Tower Staircase
rooms.desc: A spiral staircase of great flagstones around a twenty-foot core, choked with cobwebs.
rooms.dm: 300 ft from K84 to K59 around the shaft K18a. A crack 30 ft below the new wall leads to the wine cellar's air.

rooms.name: South Tower Stair
rooms.desc: A spiral stair in a round tower, torches guttering in a cold draught.
rooms.dm: From K73 (-80) up past K61, K9, K30 and K35 to K47.

rooms.name: Guards' Stair
rooms.desc: A bare, windy staircase.
rooms.dm: From K68 (-40) past K13 to K46 (+90).

rooms.name: Heart of Sorrow
rooms.desc: A round tower hall; a spiral stair hugs the outer wall and another stair in the centre leads down.
rooms.dm: The Heart of Sorrow: the tower is alive. Stair: +50 landing (K13 arch, secret ladder to K34), +90 landing (K45/K46), +190 beneath the heart, then K60.

rooms.name: Creaky Landing
rooms.desc: An old wooden staircase that groans underfoot.
rooms.dm: Climbs from K16 to the balcony K28 (+50); nothing up there is surprised.

rooms.name: Servants' Entrance
rooms.desc: A dusty room with a dirt-caked east window; a door beside it, a broken door north, a stair plunging south. Two skeletal figures in chain mail sag at attention beside the stair.
rooms.dm: The skeletons are wired dummies (Cyrus Belview's work). The stair descends to K62 (-40). East door swollen: DC 10 Strength.

rooms.name: Servants' Quarters
rooms.desc: Dim servants' quarters; a narrow railless stair climbs along the north wall.
rooms.dm: The stair leads to K34 (+50).

objects.label: Balcony over the cliff: the village lies a thousand feet below; a window-set stone box juts from the cliff 100 ft down (K63).
Four stone dragons on the vaulted ceiling (red dragon wyrmlings when roused)
Eight gargoyles squat on the rim of the dome; they attack anyone who returns after leaving.
The feast is an illusion; the organ plays itself. Strahd may greet the party here.
A black mace on the floor by the altar; a cloaked figure draped over the altar
Balcony along the west wall 50 ft up (K28), two thrones at its centre.
Elevator shaft, 170 ft: from K61 (-40 ft) past K31 (+50) and K31b (+90) to K47 (+130).
Stair wraps the shaft (K18a) 300 ft from the catacombs (K84) to the peak (K59). A new wall blocks it 10 ft below the landing west of K17.
